headline: 53% of Wio Personal's 1,335 written reviews are five stars and 37% are one or two. Praise is for onboarding and the interface; the complaints are about support that answers slowly and about access: video verification, device checks and VPN detection.
lede: Wio answers 95% of written reviews, typically within 2 day. The review base is small (1,335 reviews since 25 July 2023), so the months with at least 15 reviews hold 16 to 51 reviews and move on a handful of voices. Written reviews average 3.43; reviews from 2026 average 3.16, those before 2025 average 3.63.
method: Averages here are of written reviews only. Store ratings (4.80 App Store, 4.61 Google Play) include star-only ratings, which are not public and skew positive. Sentiment comes from the star rating (1-2 negative, 4-5 positive, 3 resolved by wording). Themes are keyword-tagged, so a review can carry several themes. Months with fewer than 15 reviews are not read as trends. App Store coverage: complete.

events.label: Early transfer delays and a silent call centre
events.detail: 45 reviews in December 2023. 10 reviews across December and January mention being unable to reach support while a transfer or login OTP failed.

events.label: First outgoing transfer blocked by the address form
events.detail: 2 reviews in January 2024 describe the app rejecting a valid residential address on the first international transfer; the two most upvoted came from the same week.

events.label: Trading fees and a lower rate noticed
events.detail: 9 reviews in spring 2024 mention fees or the savings rate; the most helpful says trading was fee-free and the rate higher a few months earlier.

events.label: Best month with at least 15 reviews
New card feature and export complaints
events.detail: Average 3.4 across 47 reviews. Reviewers report a new feature that stopped card payments and an export that splits transactions into two files.

events.label: Device support dropped, custom OS flags
events.detail: 13 reviews between July and October 2026 mention an unsupported device, a custom operating system warning or VPN detection, including users abroad who cannot reach their money.

events.label: Lowest month with at least 15 reviews
events.detail: Average 2.55 across 29 reviews. Negative themes: Call centre & chat (10), Missing features (3), Account & onboarding (3).

pains.title: Support that answers slowly, or not at all
pains.summary: Support is the most common negative theme (158 reviews). People describe WhatsApp messages that go unanswered, calls only possible from inside the UAE, hour-long waits and agents who take several minutes per reply.

quotes.body: Difficult to setup. Freezes up often. Many features simply don't work with no explanation of why they don't work or what is needed to make them work. customer care basically doesn't exist. you have 2 options. whatsapp(they don't respond) or call them which you can only do from inside the UAE. So if you have a problem while abroad you're out of luck. They frequently block transactions with no explanation or even an alert that they did so. Don't deposit more than you are willing to lose!
worst bank to bank with.... waiting time is just more than 1 hr for simple banking queries on a scale of 0 to 5, I'll definitely give them -100

App experience is best in class....but... the Support is so slow, At 2PM i contacted agent amd got reply at 10PM even then the agent was taking 9 to 10 mins per response and query remained un resolved...

Everything was fine until I tried to open a family account. I contacted support via WhatsApp; a case was opened but not resolved. After follow-ups, another case was opened and later closed as “resolved” even though the issue remained. Agents said they could not reopen or escalate it, and one even said her shift had ended and she wanted to leave. The app is good, but the customer support is very poor and unprofessional. Reference case ID 519361, 530115, 4734024

pains.title: Locked out by device and location checks
pains.summary: Video verification repeats, a device stops being supported, a stock Android is read as a custom operating system, and users in Hong Kong or abroad are told they are on a VPN. Each leaves a customer unable to repay a card or move money.

quotes.body: Imagine being completely locked out of your bank while you're abroad. Amazing experience. I can't repay my credit card, change my investments, approve transactions, or do anything at all. All because they decided to stop supporting my device. I highly discourage anyone from having their salary paid into this app or even using it in the first place, if you want to avoid ending up in the same situation. Now I have to buy a new device just to close my account and move everything elsewhere.

It has worked for 2 years without issue before today. I've tried rebooting. Please advise how I DM you - I cannot open the app, and the support email address listed isn't valid.

Yesterday I saw notification saying there is a delay and transfer can take upto 3 days ! Tried several times to get it touch with support. Never had a chance to talk even on chat. Very risky.

pains.title: Fees and rates that changed
pains.summary: A digital bank that markets itself as low fee is held to it: trading fees, a lower savings rate and a fixed saving rate that fell from 6% to 5% while the app still said 'up to 6%' are the complaints.

quotes.body: The app and user experience are amazing. 2 comments. 1. There were no fees on trading and the interest rate was higher few months ago. No there are fees on every trade and the interest rate is lower. This breaks the trust and makes the user skeptical whether Wio will keep on adding fees and they used the high interest and zero fees to lure in customers. 2. Don't let the back button get you out of the app, ask if you want yo exit or not, otherwise i have to sign in again.

Edited to one star. They have released a new feature but it doesn't work. So I am not able to use my card to make any payments. The one thing I need a card to do. Very frustrating. The app itself works well, but there are too many hidden fees. Things are advertised as "fee-free" but are then so convoluted and hidden that they still charge you fees anyway. I've been charged aed1000 through these fees over the past few months and it's really irritating
Fixed saving is only 5% now instead of 6%. In the app is still written "up to 6%" but there is no such option any more.

pains.title: Missing everyday banking features
pains.summary: Tap-to-withdraw at ATMs, SMS cash withdrawal, one CSV export of all transactions and easy access to card details are the specific absences named.

quotes.body: Good app. But 2 problems: 1 - Tapping phone at ATM can withdrawal not working. (Google Pay/Garmin Pay not working) 2 - SMS cash withdrawal feature also not available. Since you are a digital bank, really surprising above 2 features are missing. Please fix the issues. Thank you.

Wio for god sake. Who decided, to do not give, one export with all transactions in csv! You give 2 exports and the credit transactions only as a pdf. Let go the person who decided this. Give us one export with all transactions in csv. I raided multiple tickets about the same

I wish my bank app thought of itself as my personal bank app and not an advertising billboard. the app is FULL of advertisements, trying to upsell me products I don't care about. yet, when it comes to finding my card details it's buried beneath menus. wio should sort it's priorities out - stop trying to upsell your customers when you can't get basic user journeys to feel nice and intuitive. and STOP sending me notifications & emails every other day about space x IPOs or bitcoin - I DONT CARE!!!

Especially for all those who cannot submit there salary certificates can easily get this bank in literally minutes without any hassle. Love it will definitely recommend to everyone i ever meet again.

Amazing onboarding process. Brilliantly simple and efficient app. Digital banks need to take a cue from Wio. Even the physical card arrived ahead of schedule. Adding your own personal picture from the gallery for the saving space and the physical card would be a nice option to have.

wins.title: An interface people call best in class

Just one small bug but that I assume is cuz you designed for ios first is when I click the bsck button sometimes it just exits the app. If you can fix that. I would appreciate it you work on adding Samsung pay to the accepted mobile wallets.

However, I’m receiving multiple emails every day with the title *“Login activity detected ⚠️”*, even though there’s no suspicious activity on my account. I’ve already changed my PIN and contacted customer service, but the issue hasn’t been resolved. These emails feel more like spam than helpful notifications, and it’s becoming frustrating. "Edit: I stopped receiving those emails since 17-4-2025"

wins.title: One app for savings, stocks and cards
wins.summary: Customers like having savings, stocks, crypto and credit card payments in one place, while asking for search and sort on the investment list.

Updated Review: Support reached out (a bit late) and explained the situation. Issues were resolved with a promise of minimising them in the future. Everything is running smoothly now. Some upgrades are much needed on the investment interface, though. Providing more trading related data, etc... Original Review: Unable to login to the app. I did everything, still doesn't work. Support are not responding. How can an app that offers investments, glitch in the middle of a trading day?! Very risky!

wins.title: Real people when it works
wins.summary: When support reaches a customer it is praised: no automated service, professional staff who respond, and follow-up after a public review.

No AI or automated service. you speak with real people who are very professional and responsive. Please do not change that Wio. I ve never been an advocate to any brand in my entire life but I ve been telling all my friends and family abt Wio.
